metaDescription: List your rental fleet on Veltrio with 0% commission. One flat subscription covers fleet software, online bookings and payouts straight to your Stripe account.

hero.title: Run your rental business. Keep every dollar.
hero.description: One subscription covers the software that runs your fleet and your listing on the marketplace. We take 0% of every booking.

find.title: Renters find you
find.description: Your vehicles appear when renters search by city and dates, with no extra data entry.

page.title: Your own branded page
page.description: A page for your fleet at yourcompany.{domain}, under your name and your terms.

approve.title: You approve every booking

paid.title: Paid straight to you
paid.description: Connect your Stripe account and every payment is paid out to it. We never hold your money.

ours.title: Veltrio
ours.fee: No renter fees: renters pay the price you set
ours.payout: Payments go straight to your Stripe account

calendar.title: Your whole fleet at a glance
calendar.description: A calendar of every car: which one is out, with whom, and when it's due back. Requests still waiting for your answer stand out.
calendar.alt: The Veltrio calendar for a five-car fleet over one week, each booking a coloured bar with the renter's name and dates.

site.title: Bookings from anywhere
site.description: Your own booking site at yourcompany.{domain}, and your cars in the marketplace search. Every request comes straight to you, with no commission.
site.alt: A rental company's booking site: its name over a photo of a car, then its fleet with each car's daily price.

checks.title: Checked before the keys go
checks.description: Run background and insurance checks on a renter from the booking, and check every driver's licence at handover before the car leaves.
checks.alt: A booking's checklist: background check clear, ID verification successful and insurance verification covered.

payment.title: Signed and paid before pickup
payment.description: Send the rental agreement to sign online and a secure link to pay. The security deposit is held on the renter's card until the car comes back.
payment.alt: A renter's payment page for an Audi R8 with the pick-up and return details, the amount due and the security deposit held on the card.

payouts.title: Your money, your Stripe
payouts.description: Renters pay into your own Stripe account, and Stripe pays out to your bank. Veltrio never holds your money. Receipts, refunds and deposit releases are a click away on the booking.
payouts.alt: A booking's payment card: paid in full by card, with invoice, receipt and refund buttons, and a security deposit on hold with a button to release it.

items.branches: Several branches, each with its own address and opening hours.
items.languages: English and Spanish, for your staff and your renters.
items.ai: Vehicle descriptions written for you by AI, ready to edit.
items.import: Bring your existing fleet in from a spreadsheet.

pricingSummary.description: Plans from {price} a month, or save {percent}% or more paying yearly. Every plan includes the full software and your marketplace listing, and starts with a {trialDays}-day free trial.

plans.enterprise: For large fleets with needs of their own.

pricingPage.metaDescription: Flat monthly or yearly plans for rental companies, sized to your fleet, with 0% commission and a free trial. Verification credits for renter checks.
pricingPage.title: Simple pricing. No commission.
pricingPage.intro: One flat subscription sized to your fleet, with the full software and your marketplace listing in every plan. Pay monthly, or a year up front and save {percent}% or more.
pricingPage.plansNote: Every plan starts with a {trialDays}-day free trial. Prices are in US dollars.

software.title: The full software
software.description: Fleet, calendar, bookings, agreements, payments and branches. No feature is held back for a bigger plan.

listing.title: Your marketplace listing
listing.description: Your cars in the marketplace search and on your own booking site.

payments.title: Payments through Stripe
payments.description: Renters pay into your own Stripe account. Stripe's standard processing fee applies.

commission.title: 0% commission
commission.description: Renters pay the price you set, and every booking's money is yours.

credits.title: Pay only for the checks you run.
credits.description: Background and insurance checks on renters are paid for with credits, which you buy in packs ahead of time.
credits.note: Credits never expire. Your first subscription comes with {count} credits, so you can try a check during the trial.

trial.question: How does the free trial work?
trial.answer: Every plan starts with a {trialDays}-day free trial with the full software, so you can add your fleet and take bookings before you pay.

yearly.question: Monthly or yearly?
yearly.answer: Either. Paying a year up front costs less: {percent}% or more off twelve monthly payments, depending on the plan.

change.question: Can I change plans later?
change.answer: Yes. Your company's owner can move to another plan from the billing settings in the portal.

size.question: Which plan do I need?
size.answer: The one that holds your fleet: each plan has a vehicle and branch limit. Above {count} vehicles, talk to us about Enterprise.

credits.question: What are credits for?
credits.answer: Paid renter checks. A background check uses {background} credits and an insurance check uses {insurance}. Credits never expire.

fees.question: Are there any other fees?
fees.answer: No commission and no fee per booking. Stripe charges its standard processing fee on card payments, which comes out of your Stripe account, and renters pay no fee to Veltrio.

cost.question: What does Veltrio cost?
cost.answer: A flat subscription sized to your fleet, from {price} a month. There is no commission and no charge per booking.

share.question: Does Veltrio take a share of my bookings?
share.answer: No. Renters pay the price you set, and all of it is yours. Our only income is your subscription.

paid.question: How do I get paid?
paid.answer: You connect your own Stripe account, and renters' online payments are paid out to it. Stripe charges its standard processing fee. You can also take cash at pick-up.

who.question: Who can list on Veltrio?
who.answer: Rental companies only. Veltrio is for businesses that rent out vehicles; private owners cannot list a personal car.

decline.question: Can I decline a booking request?
decline.answer: Yes. Every request waits for your confirmation, and the renter is not charged until you accept it.

trial.question: Is there a free trial?
trial.answer: Yes. Every plan starts with a {trialDays}-day free trial, so you can add your fleet and take bookings before you pay.
